description: Ex-French Air Force Jaguar A (French serial A105), one of about 31 French airframes imported by HAL as a spares source; never served with the IAF but displayed in IAF colours with the number A-105 on the nose gear door. Reported 2022 via Google Maps photos (warbirds.in). French nose and tail distinguish it from IAF Jaguars.
aliases: A-105; JS105; Jaguar A; French Jaguar; A105
